meta.title: Scientists Just Found an Ocean Where It Shouldn't Exist #shorts
meta.description:
Have you ever wondered what is actually inside the Earth? You probably picture red-hot magma and solid rock, but scientists discovered something that changes everything. Deep within the mantle, four hundred miles beneath your feet, lies a colossal water reservoir. We are not talking about a small underground lake. This hidden ocean holds three times more water than all surface oceans combined. It is trapped inside a bright blue, sponge-like rock called ringwoodite, which soaks up water under intense pressure. This means the planet's water cycle goes much deeper than we ever realized. If this water ever leaked to the surface, only mountain peaks would remain above water. Do you think there is more undiscovered water out there? Drop a comment and follow for more mind-blowing science!
